description: Header file defining functions and structures for SMP re-assembly in the Zephyr project, related to managing fragmented data packets over transport.

methods.name: smp_reassembly_init
methods.description: Initializes the re-assembly context within an SMP transport.

methods.name: smp_reassembly_collect
methods.description: Adds data to the re-assembly buffer, potentially allocating new buffer, and returns expected bytes left.

methods.name: smp_reassembly_expected
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes needed to complete the current packet re-assembly.

methods.name: smp_reassembly_complete
methods.description: Checks if the packet has enough data to be re-assembled and passes it for processing, with optional forcing.

methods.name: smp_reassembly_drop
methods.description: Drops the current packet and releases the buffer.

methods.name: smp_reassembly_get_ud
methods.description: Retrieves the user data pointer associated with the current re-assembly process.
